defect: The change inverts the loop flag in sceSasSetVoice and sceSasSetVoicePCM (v.loop = loop ? false : true), so voices that request looping do not loop and vice versa.
reason: The fix restores loop ? true : false in exactly these changed lines and repairs the real loop bug in SasAudio.cpp, showing the inversion was a wrong workaround for a decoder bug.

defect: The added version parsing does strcpy(buffer, versionStr) into a 64-byte buffer without a null check or length limit, so a null or long GL_VERSION string crashes or overflows the stack buffer.
reason: The fix replaces the added strcpy with a null-checked, zero-initialised strncpy and limits the parse to desktop GL, repairing lines this change added.

defect: The change moves textureShaderInfo.clear() from the start of LoadPostShaderInfo to after the loading loop, which wipes every texture shader just loaded and never clears stale entries before loading.
reason: The fix moves the clear back to the start and inserts the Off entry at the front, undoing the misplaced clear introduced here.

defect: The fix only corrects a log format string that passes three arguments to two format specifiers.
reason: Extra printf arguments are harmless; the fix is a warning cleanup of a log message, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix replaces a char comparison against NULL with a comparison against the null character.
reason: Comparing a char with NULL is semantically identical to comparing with zero; the fix silences a compiler warning only.

defect: The fix widens msToCycles/usToCycles return types and ScheduleEvent's argument to s64 to stop int overflow in scheduling.
reason: The overflow comes from the pre-existing int-returning helpers and int ScheduleEvent parameter; the u64 overload added here computes correctly and is only retyped by the fix.

defect: AddOtherChoice pushes view pointers into otherChoices_ on every CreateViews without clearing it, so after a view recreation update() calls SetVisibility on deleted views (crash), and update() calls the heavy GetSaveDataDirectories every frame (lag).
reason: The fix clears otherChoices_ and moves GetSaveDataDirectories out of update(), repairing both problems in lines this change added.

defect: OnPointClick sends NKCODE_PERIOD with KEY_CHAR, but with KEY_CHAR the code is read as a character, and NKCODE_PERIOD is not the character '.', so the dot button inserts the wrong character.
reason: The fix restores the character '.' in exactly the line this change rewrote; seeing that NKCODE_PERIOD differs from '.' requires the keycode header.

defect: The fix only rewords a debug log message for switching render targets.
reason: A log text change repairs no functional defect.

defect: The change scales vpY0 and vpHeight by renderWidthFactor_ instead of renderHeightFactor_ in UpdateViewportAndProjection.
reason: The fix restores renderHeightFactor_ in the lines this change altered; the code currently sits after an early return, so the defect is latent, but it is a clear copy error introduced here.

defect: The fix drops the extern keyword from the initialised VFPOpNames definition.
reason: An extern declaration with an initializer is a valid definition that only triggers a warning; the fix is a warning cleanup.

defect: The fix casts SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_NOCWD to int in the comparison with the int error code and reformats a pointer declaration.
reason: The signed/unsigned comparison already gave the correct result; the fix silences a warning.

defect: The fix adds parentheses around the && subexpressions of the viewport-size condition.
reason: && already binds tighter than ||, so the condition behaved as intended; the fix only silences a precedence warning.

defect: The fix shortens the debug labels printed by FragmentShaderDesc in the shader viewer.
reason: Renaming debug description strings is cosmetic, not a defect repair.

defect: The added gpuCommandsAtCallLevel statistic is incremented by the doubled cycle count (2 * commands) instead of the number of commands executed.
reason: The fix makes executed the command count and doubles only the cycle counters, correcting the statistic added in this change.

defect: The fix wraps the SOCOM lookup expression in parentheses so the whole sum, not only its last term, is multiplied by index_multiplier.
reason: The unparenthesised lookup expression (index.b * 64.0 + index.g * 4.0) was already broken the same way before this change, which only added the index.a term.

defect: The fix retunes the size and position of the Yes/No/OK button boxes and the border lines of the message dialog.
reason: These are layout adjustments to on-screen dialog drawing, not a repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix adds a portrait flag so the control mapping rows use a flexible width in portrait orientation.
reason: Portrait layout support is a feature; this change only dropped a namespace qualifier in the constructor.

defect: The added STRIP_PSP code checks startsWith(path, '/PSP') after the leading slash was already erased, so it never strips the PSP prefix, and the file handle's fileSystemFlags_ is never set.
reason: The fix tests for 'PSP/' and sets entry.hFile.fileSystemFlags_ in OpenFile and DoState, repairing the workaround this change added.

defect: In this file the fix only adds braces, translates the Chat button label and adds a comment.
reason: None of the fix's changes in this file repairs a defect introduced by gating the chat button on the setting.

defect: The fix regroups the atlas character groups (S becomes the select symbols, new J holds the ShiftJIS ranges) and updates the atlas scripts accordingly.
reason: This is a reorganisation of font-atlas group letters and tool configuration, not a repair of a crash or wrong code result.

defect: The new software alpha blending is applied whenever alpha blending is enabled, including in clear mode, where the PSP does not blend.
reason: The fix adds !gstate.isModeClear() to the blend condition this change added; knowing clear mode disables blending needs GPU knowledge outside the diff.

defect: The fix wraps through-mode texture coordinates to the texture size and guards a null texture pointer to avoid crashes.
reason: The out-of-range texel coordinates existed before; this change only added explicit casts and default returns.

defect: The fix extends the save reminder and save indicator to invisible save and load types and stops showing the indicator for deletes.
reason: Missing tracking for invisible save types predates this change; the fix extends and refactors the new indicator rather than repairing a defect in it.

defect: The fix applies per-channel volume during mixing and clamps the mixed samples instead of shifting them by 2.
reason: Channel volume was ignored before this change, which only refactored queue pops and log wording.

defect: The fix guards srcXOffset = (byteOffset / bpp) % srcStride against a zero srcStride.
reason: This block-transfer code was moved verbatim from GPU/GLES/Framebuffer.cpp, where the same modulo already existed before this change.

defect: The fix stores and kills the audio timer and stops deleting feed, which is owned by QAudioOutput.
reason: The crash on close comes from the pre-existing delete feed in the destructor; the timer is destroyed with the QObject on the main thread after the event loop ends.

defect: The fix corrects the end-of-function log message in audioInit, which said audioShutdown.
reason: A copy-pasted log string is a cosmetic typo, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix dispatches a fresh EventParams e2 instead of modifying and redispatching the incoming e in ChoiceStrip::OnChoiceClick.
reason: The old code dispatched the same view and index, so behaviour was equivalent; the fix removes confusing code.

defect: The change comments out the first RotateUVs check, which is the correct swap condition for one through-mode rectangle orientation, so those rectangles lose their UV rotation.
reason: The fix's RotateUVThrough re-enables that condition together with the other one; whether it is correct depends on PSP hardware behaviour not visible in code.

defect: The fix inserts a line break into the default text of the restore-defaults prompt so it fits on screen.
reason: This is a cosmetic text layout change, not a functional defect.

defect: The fake sceFontGetCharGlyphImage memsets bytesPerLine*bufHeight*pixelFormat bytes, multiplying the buffer size by the pixel format code and overflowing the game's glyph buffer.
reason: The fix removes the pixelFormat factor from the memset this change added.

defect: The fix passes the Instance header text through the translation category.
reason: An untranslated UI string is a localisation issue, not a functional defect.

defect: GetSamplingParams calls entry->CacheKey() whenever texture replacement is enabled, but GetFramebufferSamplingParams now passes a null entry, so it dereferences a null pointer and crashes.
reason: The fix guards entry before calling CacheKey(), repairing the null dereference this change introduced along with the nullptr call site.

defect: The fix sets gstate's through-mode flag around immediate-vertex submission so vertex and fragment shaders match, and limits the fog and color1 warnings to non-through mode.
reason: This change only added a fog warning log; the shader mismatch comes from the existing fake through-vertex path in DispatchSubmitImm.

defect: The fix in FlushImm adds viewport, UV-scale and cull-range dirty flags and restores state only when it changed, to accompany the through-mode toggle that fixes a vertex/fragment shader mismatch.
reason: The crash stems from submitting fake through vertices while gstate is not in through mode, which predates this change; the GPUCommon edits support the new toggle rather than repair lines added here.

defect: The fix stores the shader module as a Promise owned by VKShaderModule instead of wrapping it in a new Promise on every pipeline creation, which leaked.
reason: The leaking Promise wrap was introduced by an earlier commit (e828df9f25); this change only added a debug tag argument to CreateShaderModule.

defect: The new QuickTexHash hashes only w columns per row and skips the bufw padding, which misses changes in swizzled or padded texture layouts (and steps backwards when bufw is smaller than w), so changed textures are not detected.
reason: The fix goes back to hashing the whole texture buffer, undoing the row/pad hashing this change added after it caused wrong textures.

defect: The change moves LogManager::Init and the console Open(hideLog, ...) call before the command-line loop, so the -l flag that clears hideLog is parsed too late and the log window is not shown.
reason: The fix moves log initialisation back after argument parsing, repairing the ordering this change introduced.

defect: ProcessInput looks up SDLJoyAxisMap and SDLJoyButtonMap with std::map operator[], so unmapped axes or buttons default to code 0 and are reported as the X axis (or keycode 0).
reason: The fix uses find() and ignores unmapped entries in exactly these new lines; seeing that unknown axes map to 0 requires the mapping table in the header.
